title: Louder Standing Still

mood.label: Uneasy standoff
mood.summary: A pressure campaign renamed as regime collapse: sanctions instead of strikes, Beijing refusing to join, oil up and stocks down, missiles over the drills, vigil organisers convicted, the canal narrowing. Underneath it, vaccines moving and a cancer trial that worked.

lines: They swapped the shooting for the squeeze —
toughest hand in history, they said.
Beijing said no: sanctions settle nothing.
Brent climbed a second week, yields climbed,
and missiles went up as the drills wound down.
The standoff gets louder standing still.
Hold the line, hold the line —
hold the small good things too.
Two names guilty for lighting candles,
the canal counting down to thirty-four a day,
eight hundred running from the hills of Spain.
Then: a gate opens, two walk out,
seventy thousand doses in the air,
a needle teaching the blood to fight.
